blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States — A US jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei of stealing trade secrets Tuesday, but acquitted it of a more serious racketeering allegation, media reported. The world’s leading telecom equipment manufacturer, Huawei, has been targeted by the Trump administration, which alleges it could spy on behalf of the Chinese government. The United States has previously urged countries not to use Huawei infrastructure for the rollout of new 5G mobile networks. The verdict followed an 11-week trial at a Brooklyn federal court during which Huawei had strenuously denied wrongdoing, The New York Times reported. READ: Europe considers cutting out […]...
